reason: I already have an Instagram page that orders from China for me and I know how they work, so I don't see why I'd switch to a new page nobody I know has tried. And half the time I can find something close in the Baghdad market today without waiting three weeks.
objection: 21,000 IQD in fees on a 30,000 shoe is almost as much as the shoe itself, and I'm paying up front to a name I've never heard of, with no returns if it doesn't fit.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or someone I follow getting their order from them on time, with the warehouse photo matching what arrived, and the driver actually finding my house.
